title: Breast cancer tumor OU-1
treatment_protocol_ch1: Patients prospectively consented to a research biopsy by vacuum-assisted core-biopsy instrument (Mammotome 8G; HH Ethicon Endosurgery, Johnson and Johnson Company) under ultrasonographic guidance for histologic examination and gene expression analysis prior to any systemic therapy, and to the future assessment of pathologic response
extract_protocol_ch1: Trizol (Invitrogen, Carlsbad, Calif) was used to extract RNA from core-needle tumor biopsy samples that were obtained with the Mammotome.
label_protocol_ch1: RNA (50 ng) was subjected to the generation of second-strand combinational DNA (cDNA), and cRNA was amplified with a random primer (WT-Ovation FFPE RNA Amplification System V2; NuGEN, Cincinnati, Ohio). Next, the amplified cRNA was biotinylated and fragmented with the FL-Ovation cDNA Biotin Module V2 (NuGEN).
hyb_protocol: Following fragmentation, 5 ug of cRNA were hybridized overnight at 46C on Affymetrix U133 plus2.0 arrays. GeneChips were washed and stained in the Affymetrix GeneChip Fluidics Station 450.
scan_protocol: GeneChips were scanned using the diagnostic-grade Affymetrix scanner 3000.
data_processing: Probe intensities were quantified with Microarray Suite version 5.0 (MAS 5.0) using Affymetrix default analysis settings.
